question: Where is the closest museum situated on the southeast side of Our Lady of the Rivers Shrine, Portage Des Sioux, MO?
sql:
WITH origin AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-90.338654 38.931031)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois,origin
WHERE pois.tourism = 'museum'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> origin.geometry ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Our Lady of the Rivers Shrine, Portage Des Sioux, MO

poi.poi_name: Our Lady of the Rivers Shrine
poi.description: Our Lady of the Rivers Shrine gets its name from the fact that three major rivers-the Illinois, Missouri, and the Mississippi-meet within a few miles of the site. Dedicated October 1957 to commemorate an event in July 1951.
